job: Get a reader connected by choosing their tool, with the steps for it below.
purpose: A card with a row of tiles (one per tool or client) and a panel for the chosen one. The chosen tile has an accent top rule and a 4% accent wash. Use it once, near the top of an introduction. The same file also holds the numbered steps (fd-doc-steps), where each step holds prose and code on a rail.
useWhen: The same setup differs by tool and the reader needs only their own.
A setup must happen in order and each step has prose and code.

avoidWhen.when: Instructions that differ by language or framework within an article.
A first-run flow in the product.

states.name: chosen
states.how: aria-selected="true" on the tile; the panel with the same data-value shows

parts.role: One tool; data-value pairs it with a panel.
A muted line under a step.
Numbered steps on a rail; each step holds prose and code.

keyboard.does: Moves to the previous or next tile.
Moves to the first or last tile.
